timeline.why: Kane found no way to refuse cookies, and 4 tracker requests went out before the visitor made any choice.
timeline.kaneSummary:
The requested task was to open a page using the site navigation and reload it.
No cookie or analytics consent banner was shown, so no consent action was needed.
Opened the About page and reloaded it successfully.

timeline.summary:
Wrong: `index.html` and `ghpages.html` loaded the Google tag (gtag) as soon as `haxcms-ready` fired, with no consent check and no way to refuse.

Changed: `loadAnalyticsFromManifest()` now loads the tag only if the stored choice is "granted", stops if it's "denied", and otherwise shows an Accept/Decline banner; Accept saves the choice and loads the tag, Decline saves it and nothing loads. I haven't run it in a browser, and `node --check` can't check JavaScript inside HTML files.

timeline.why: Kane refused cookies and recorded 312 requests; none went to a known tracker and no visitor ID was sent.
timeline.kaneSummary:
The request was to open a page from the site navigation and then reload it.
A cookie or analytics consent banner was shown and its decline option was selected before continuing.
The About page was opened from the site navigation and then reloaded successfully.

timeline.why: After "Accept", the tags loaded as intended (google-analytics.com).
timeline.kaneSummary:
Accepted the site’s cookie or analytics consent prompt.
Opened the About page from the site navigation.
The requested navigation was completed successfully.
